endpoints._note: Pi Zero 2 W rig-monitor (WT901 incline + quadrature tach) on the Bay 01 treadmill (NTL17624, BLE console iFIT_Tread_1C5F bound in lab.json) since 2026-09-16 (previously the NTL17915 bay u03). Reach the Pi directly by its mDNS name on the lab Wi-Fi (192.168.1.134). With this source owning belt_speed + incline, the bay's FP2 console attaches commander-only (setpoints out, events in) and the Pi's tach arms the unattended-motion watchdog.

incline._offset_note: Tare: the WT901 grade board read +2.64 % with the NTL17624 deck at 0 % (console CURRENT_GRADE 0) on 2026-09-16. Re-tare after remounting: set offset 0, read the at-rest incline, put its negative here, restart the server.
